vulnerability_title: [M-01] Session signatures replay across wallets due to missing wallet binding

recommendation.recommendation_text: Bind the signature preimage to the executing wallet. The simplest fix is to include `address(this)` (or another wallet-unique value) in `SessionSig.hashCallWithReplayProtection`. Update the SDK/tooling so session signers hash `(wallet, chainId, space, nonce, callIdx, call details)`. Ensure test suites cover cross-wallet replay attempts after the change.

poc.poc_text:
* Code: `test/extensions/sessions/SessionReplay.t.sol`
* Command:
  `forge test --match-test test_crossWalletSessionReplayDrainsSiblingWallet -vv`
* Logs show an attacker replaying the same signature to drain two wallets:

  
```

  Attacker balance before: 0.000000000000000000
  WalletA balance before: 1.000000000000000000
  WalletB balance before: 1.000000000000000000
  Attacker balance after: 2.000000000000000000
  WalletA balance after: 0.000000000000000000
  WalletB balance after: 0.000000000000000000
  
```
